scope: Two newest returns; static source inspection only; recommendations not implementations or approvals
ranked_builds: Public visible-projection content identifier and batch writer

decisions.name: Atomic pending audit/ticket draw journal
decisions.reason: Current function persists seed/contracts after source verification. Missing asset/interruption loses draw; recovery script documents one exception, not a generic implementation. Reuse native main-draw lock/journal pattern.
decisions.adoption_checks: Missing asset; interruption after seed and first verify and contract write; concurrency; explicit different seed rejected; resume yields same targets; missing ancillary TICKETS/RESULTS repaired idempotently.

decisions.name: Public visible-projection content identifier and batch writer
decisions.consumer: task-local parametric exporters; native reviewer_support or small public-export API
decisions.reason: Concrete settings-in-filenames leak recurs. Existing review_solve.instance_hash hashes public grids, but no shared batch writer enforcing directory names/order was found. datasets.public_episode hashes whole private episode and is not a drop-in compatible helper. Candidate writer is in source.patch, not verifier script.
decisions.adoption_checks: Private settings/answers/seed changes leave bytes/names/order unchanged; visible changes change ID; enumeration reorder unchanged; duplicate policy; new destinations only; strict visible schema; one Racket-backed retained fixture; do not silently change existing dataset IDs.

decisions.name: Sparse ZIP overlay backend
decisions.reason: Monkeypatches pathlib globally and trusts a complete hydration ledger. New small rotating projection and native runtime-closure replay address normal need with less complexity. Preserve reported 24 tests and source-scan receipt as proposal evidence.
decisions.adoption_checks: Before adoption: lost/deleted hydrated file, tampered journal, symlink, archive drift, concurrency, restore original Path methods; independent memory and integrity test; no execution qualification inferred from streamed scan.

decisions.name: Post-hoc census compression
decisions.reason: Existing lesson-census --gzip plus native gzip evidence closure provides the supported path. Returned script deletes original after verified round-trip and modifies summary; do not introduce another default workflow.
decisions.adoption_checks: Preserve compressed/raw hashes and payload closure through native retention; do not run returned deletion utility automatically.

decisions.name: Temporary evidence archive/restore
decisions.reason: Hardcoded KEEP_TASKS,300-400MB selection and archive+unlink/restore workaround. Smaller projection removes normal need; utility is not a generic exporter or validator.
decisions.adoption_checks: Crash after archive creation/during deletion/during restore; monotonic receipt; path safety; existing-file mismatch; exact archive and restored hashes; never run implicitly.

decisions.name: Current parametric manifest verifier
decisions.reason: Small hardcoded assertion around Catalog+build_parametric_priority already implemented; no new shared tool needed.
decisions.adoption_checks: Keep exact prototype inventory and source/rule binding; current means retained evidence current, not variant approval.

decisions.name: Canonical-distinction coverage gate
decisions.consumer: 20d2c3da584a targeted repair and future semantic-gate enhancement
decisions.reason: AST exhaustion of four2-cell-wide templates is concrete evidence. Proposed generic gate is not implemented. Existing semantic rivals, canonical witness hooks, census and schedule enumeration should consume declarations; avoid parallel gate and new blanket requirement.
decisions.adoption_checks: First add task-local hollow-interior witness/rival with Racket labels and negative/positive controls. Generic extension only after second independent case demonstrates missing shared capability; preserve unknown for undeclared/unreachable domains.

decisions.name: Adversarial probes04e/5a0
decisions.reason: Source-specific ambiguity/missing-decoy and separator/control findings are useful minimal reproductions, not shared commands.
decisions.adoption_checks: Preserve exact audited source/rule IDs, seed/inputs, Racket receipt and declared domain; review before executing; no automatic source approval or audit closure.

decisions.name: Adversarial and supplemental task probes
decisions.consumer: specific audit targets and explicit recovered-draw evidence
decisions.reason: No shared abstraction needed. Supplemental original first target remains separate from completed recovery contract.
decisions.adoption_checks: Bind each target source independently; preserve recovery exception; no fabricated original seed or second target.

decisions.name: Allocation audit calculator
decisions.consumer: allocation ticket and owner experiment decision
decisions.reason: Contains packet-specific sampledIDs and hypothetical costs. It supports one bounded proposal; new ticket workflow replaces universal analysis.
decisions.adoption_checks: Report current projection versus full owner pool; source-bound denominators; do not promote hypothetical gain to measured benefit or silently change policy.

decisions.name: Final label/parity/replay probes
decisions.reason: Purposeful task validation but duplicates native apply/replay mechanisms at general-tool level; preserve task invocation and limits.
decisions.adoption_checks: Exact canonical/source/patch hashes; separate input/output parity and Racket execution from finite-rival identification.

decisions.name: Racket worker generation-aware rule reload
decisions.reason: Bridge already respawns with restarted_last_call telemetry; runner retains __pg_rule handle across child replacement. Need lifecycle binding, not another generic restart layer. Not central packaging change and requires deliberate worker-death tests.
decisions.adoption_checks: Kill child between lessons; stale binding; one reload+same-attempt retry; unchanged source/rule identity; retained initial infrastructure failure; second failure stops rather than277 cascaded errors.
